title: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
headline: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
ai_overview: Silent data corruption is a GPU fault that returns wrong but plausible numbers with no error, quietly poisoning distributed training. This post adds three checks to a PyTorch DDP loop to detect it, localize the faulty node on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and hand the node to automatic recovery for replacement.
